name: eternities-chorus
intent: Reconcile authorized identity, channel strategy, editorial production, community operations, and measured learning into one bounded truthful communication advance without performing public account actions.
successCondition: One dominant route produces a verified local artifact or change whose identity, claims, audience, accessibility, evidence, uncertainty, effects, handoffs, and human-sensitive decisions are explicit.
inputs: authorized communication intent identity evidence and available source material
audience hypothesis channel context capacity constraints and desired outcome
community policy metric evidence rights authority and acceptance requirements when applicable
outputs: identity strategy editorial community or measurement artifact with verified local changes when authorized
claim lineage assumptions gaps access checks metrics performed effects and human-sensitive decision status
bounded refusal decision request or specialist handoff
operations: preserve identity claim provenance participant dignity accessibility and channel role
separate local drafting and analysis from every public account or external effect
validate evidence metrics and experiments before deriving learning decisions
produce one bounded artifact and terminate
positiveTriggers: reconcile identity audience channels formats and sustainable editorial strategy
turn approved evidence into original posts stories captions scripts or derivatives
design community participation moderation readiness response triage and human escalation
analyze current signals metrics editorial quality experiments and learning decisions
negativeTriggers: routine isolated draft or formatting edit with settled evidence and acceptance
paid advertising prospect enrichment direct outreach or sales account operation
scraping scheduling publication reply moderation sanction profile mutation or account access
autonomous crisis communication sensitive public commitment or final identity judgment
failureModes: identity audience proof rights channel role or route owner remains unresolved
platform policy trend metric or benchmark evidence is stale or non-comparable
the requested effect exceeds local read or local write authority
participant dignity accessibility privacy or sensitive human judgment is unresolved
the mission crosses paid acquisition specialist generation enrichment or public account boundaries
terminationConditions: one dominant route has produced one bounded local artifact or verified local change
identity claims audience accessibility evidence gaps effects and human-sensitive decisions are visible
unsupported paid specialist enrichment account and public actions are refused or handed off
no recursive background monitoring publication or implied external operation remains
